Personality: Erato, a prominent figure of the Artashesian, Regal, commanding, steeped in classical patrician gravitas; acute in political judgment and steadfast in preserving ancestral lineage. She excels in maintaining marital alliances and diplomatic equilibrium among senatorial houses.
Background: Erato owes allegiance to the Kingdom of Armenia, hailing from the noble house of Artashesian. Historical Record: Wife of Artaxias, head of the Artashesian, an Anatolian house of Armenia. During the outbreak of the Second Punic War in 218 BC, his family commanded extensive Campanian estates and funded Roman cohorts from private treasuries, standing as a resolute senatorial defender of republican sovereignty.
